description: Source code for CUDA JIT utilities in PyTorch, including kernel code generation, caching, and compilation management.

methods.name: get_traits_string_but_hiprtc_safe
methods.description: Returns a string with type traits, safe for HIPRTC, or default get_traits_string() if not ROCm.

methods.name: codegenOutputQuery
methods.description: Queries CUDA device properties and NVRTC version to determine compilation target and capabilities.

methods.name: calculate_io_size
methods.description: Calculates the minimum element size between inputs and outputs.

methods.name: calculate_thread_work_size
methods.description: Determines thread work size based on input/output element sizes and environment.

methods.name: generate_code
methods.description: Generates CUDA kernel code based on kernel descriptor and parameters.

methods.name: get_cache_dir
methods.description: Determines and creates cache directory for compiled kernels.

methods.name: jit_pwise_function
methods.description: Compiles or loads from cache a CUDA kernel for pointwise functions.

methods.name: initializeCudaContext
methods.description: Initializes CUDA context if not already initialized.

methods.name: launch_jitted_pwise_function
methods.description: Launches a JIT-compiled CUDA kernel with given arguments and configuration.
